title: At home
info: Home is safe when everyone knows a few rules.
Hot things, sharp things, and electricity need care.
If something spills, wipe it so nobody slips. If you are not sure, ask an adult.

questions.q: A pot on the stove can be
options: Hot even if it looks calm

questions.q: A spill on the floor should be
If you smell gas or see sparks

options: Only for the person it was given to

questions.q: Type who you should ask if you are not sure something is safe.
